requirement: Selected source remains accounted for; unknown differs from measured zero
notes: unloaded.gd is never load()/preload()d by driver.gd or by loaded.gd. Its only relationship to the fixture is being present in the case directory, which is what makes it part of the declared selected-file manifest. A provider that cannot see this file at all (rather than seeing it and reporting zero hits) fails this case differently than one that reports a false zero -- both outcomes must be distinguished in the completeness accounting, per correctness-protocol.md's population/completeness dimensions. Line numbering is one-based; lines 1-3 (extends, blank, func signature) are not body-line obligations under our convention.
author: godot-tooling-session-2026-09-19
ambiguities: If a candidate declares class_name on a loaded/preloaded script elsewhere in a later fixture, Godot's global class cache may register the class during project import even without any code path loading it. This plain-file variant sidesteps that; a class_name variant is deferred to a later tier.
